title: bonsai.memory/1
description: A memory note, or the memory index (spec §10, option D; contract §7.4; format review 3.5): one markdown file per fact, and INDEX.md, one line per note, in the folder bonsai.yaml names (documents.memory); the personal layer, on the machine under the Bonsai home's personal/, uses the same format and never enters a project. The instruction block imports the project's index; notes are read when needed. A project's notes are written by agents through base's memory skill; the personal layer is written by a person (an agent drafts a note about the person with that skill and hands it over; the guard refuses an agent's write in the Bonsai home). Read by agents, people and the studio, which indexes a project's notes like other documents (the personal layer is never forwarded, contract §2.6). bonsai check holds the budgets and the secret scan (spec §6); each layer has its own caps (the index's lines and bytes, a note's bytes), named on the reference page of lists (docs/reference/lists.md), their one home in Bonsai's code. This schema describes the frontmatter as a reader returns it (JSON); the body is the fact, why, and how to apply it (an index: one line per note). The frontmatter follows the format-1 YAML rules (contract §2.4). A writer writes every field below, in this order, null, [] or {} where it does not apply (contract §2.2); a reader treats a missing field as null, keeps an unknown one and refuses a duplicate key.

format.description: The version line, always the first key (contract §2.2). In a file made from a template it carries a one-line pointer back as a trailing comment (contract §2.8).

id.description: The note's id: M- and a slug of lower-case letters, digits and dashes, unique in its folder; null for the index.

title.description: What the note is about, one line (the index: its own title).

kind.description: A closed list: project (a fact about the project), feedback (how the person wants the work done), reference (where something is found), or index for INDEX.md (spec §10).

updated.description: The day the note was last changed, YYYY-MM-DD as text (contract §2.4): the UTC day from set 11 (contract §23; written before set 11, the writer's local day, offset unknown), taken from bonsai now --day.

source.description: Who said it, and when, as text; null for the index.

labels.description: A map of label name to value (contract §5); {} when none. Names are <namespace>.<name> with one dot.
